Welcome to Sword Art Retro!
Experience how ROBLOX was in 2014!
────────────── · · ─ ·✶· ─ · · ──────────────
Friday is our update day, we will reboot often that day!
────────────── · · ─ ·✶· ─ · · ──────────────
 🔴 Explore floors with diverse landscapes filled with secrets 
 🔵 Find rare weapons when defeating bosses!
 🟢 Slay strong opponents and discover new floors! 
 ⚫ Create or join guilds to make your own community!
 🟡 Team up with other players to tackle dungeons!
 🟤 Trade with players
────────────── · · ─ ·✶· ─ · · ──────────────
Heavily inspired by Sword Art Online [ SAO ] and the SwordBurst series by AbstractAlex
This game is in no way associated with mentioned above!
